svg.text: Track choices, rolls, point changes and your character’s version of what happened.
Gate 11 SP / 16 LP • Entry -1 SP group, -3 LP group • Requires Leader OR Builder. Max 4 participants.
After each stage is read, choose ONE player to act. A player may act once only. Apply 2×
specialty/weakness to the resulting SP/LP gain or loss.
WRITE WHAT HAPPENED FROM YOUR CHARACTER'S PERSPECTIVE
What did your character do or refuse to do?
What did your character gain or lose?
How does your character feel about the day? Did the group work well together? Are they satisfied with their performance?
Use the icons above to track SP and LP. Circle or shade boxes as points change.
